title: Exploring Mathematics in China
description: A brief educational video introducing the significance of mathematics in China's education system and its technological advancements.

scenes.script: In China, mathematics is not just a subject; it's a way of understanding the world.
scenes.prompt: A classroom scene in a Chinese school with students of diverse backgrounds engaged in math lessons, traditional Chinese decorations on the walls, teacher explaining concepts on a blackboard, children using calculators and educational tools, vibrant learning environment.

scenes.script: China has made significant progress in mean years of schooling over the last decades.
Mathematics is integrated into daily life in China, from markets to technology.
scenes.prompt: A bustling market scene in a Chinese city, vendors calculating prices with abacuses, customers engaging in transactions, traditional Chinese architecture visible in the background, vibrant colors, lively atmosphere, showcasing the practical use of math in everyday life.

scenes.script: Access to technology in education is crucial for enhancing mathematics learning in China.
